newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates up.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Tuesday in a very short market to between 10-1/4 and 10-5/16 percent from Monday's range of 10 and 10-1/4 percent, bankers said.
One week rates also went up to 10-3/8 and 10-1/2 percent from an average of 10-1/8 percent on Monday, they added.
Most bankers said they did not know any reason for the shortage, but some attributed it to large demand for the pound in preparation for new privatisations.
"It is very strange," one banker said, commenting on the state of the market.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
